# pve_notification_endpoint_smtp (Data Source)

Reads a single SMTP notification endpoint from `GET /cluster/notifications/endpoints/smtp/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_notification_endpoint_smtp" "relay" {
  name = "mailrelay"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint to look up.

### Read-Only

- `author` (String) Author of the mail.
- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether this target is disabled.
- `from_address` (String) `From` address for the mail.
- `mailto` (List of String) List of email recipients.
- `mailto_user` (List of String) List of PVE users receiving the notification.
- `mode` (String) Determine which encryption method shall be used for the connection. Must be one of: `insecure`, `starttls`, `tls`.
- `port` (Number) The port to be used.
- `server` (String) The address of the SMTP server.
- `username` (String) Username for SMTP authentication.
